home.canvas.label.note: Screen reader name of the main canvas.

home.canvas.hint.note: Screen reader hint for the main canvas.
home.canvas.hint.en: Imps move around here. Press Tab to go from one Imp to the next.
home.canvas.hint.es: Los Imps se mueven por aquí. Pulsa Tab para ir de un Imp al siguiente.
home.canvas.hint.zh-Hans: Imp 在这里走动。按 Tab 键可在各个 Imp 之间切换。

home.empty.hint.note: Empty main screen, one line under the title.
home.empty.hint.en: Hatch your first Imp to get started.
home.empty.hint.es: Haz nacer a tu primer Imp para empezar.
home.empty.hint.zh-Hans: 孵化你的第一个 Imp，就可以开始了。

home.empty.new_imp.note: The one prompt in the middle of an empty main screen.

home.hidden.title.note: The element on the floor that holds hidden Imps. The number is how many.

home.hidden.empty.note: Shown in the hidden Imps list when it is empty.

home.hidden.bring_back.note: Action that brings a hidden Imp back.

home.hidden.peek.note: Announced to screen readers when a hidden Imp peeks.
home.hidden.peek.en: {name} is peeking out from the floor.

home.hidden.hint.note: Screen reader hint for the hidden Imps element.
home.hidden.hint.en: Hidden Imps peek out now and then. Click one to bring it back.
home.hidden.hint.es: Los Imps ocultos se asoman de vez en cuando. Haz clic en uno para traerlo de vuelta.
home.hidden.hint.zh-Hans: 隐藏的 Imp 会不时探出头来。点击它，它就会回来。

home.tray.show.note: Status icon menu item that shows the window.

home.tray.quit.note: Status icon menu item that quits the app.

home.corner.show_hidden.note: Help and screen reader name of the corner button that brings every hidden Imp back. The number of hidden Imps is shown on the button.
